concepts.title: Closed Mouth, Endless Corridor
concepts.what_we_see: Tight on his face as he holds a still, knowing look through the clear glasses, mouth closed; behind him the light strips recede and multiply in the mirrors like a speech that rambles on without him.
concepts.why_it_lands: He performs the lyric by not speaking — presence plus the infinite corridor lets the money do the rambling.
concepts.camera: slow push-in to a tight portrait, then a slight pull that reveals the receding lights
concepts.motion_and_fx: almost no body motion, only atmosphere: lights breathing, reflections sliding on the wet floor
concepts.risk_reason: simple facial stillness and a slow camera move on the existing plate, no extra objects or fast physics
